title: Stargate ends in 1995 and Puharich is silenced

tellings.quote: Stargate officially ends in 95, government puts out newspaper articles all over the news, you know, Stargate there's nothing to it. It was all bunk.

plain: Stargate, a US government programme that used psychics to try to see distant places with the mind, officially ended in 1995, and the government then filled the news with articles saying there was nothing to it and it was all bunk. An unnamed researcher tells this to Jesse Michels, drawing on the journalist Annie Jacobsen and tying it to Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic abilities who, the story says, was silenced. The point of telling it is that the public dismissal may have been a cover rather than an honest ending.
